extraction_hints: On the OR Record (and H&P) 'Attending Surgeon:' tick-box line, the printed options on this mission are KC / VB / ZS. Report whichever is ticked/circled exactly as printed -- do not expect any other initials (note: this is a 3-initial set, unlike some other Ghana missions which have a 4th 'AB' option).
On the OR Record 'Assistant:' tick-box line, the printed options on this mission are PJ / KK / AC / VP / AG. Report whichever is ticked exactly as printed -- do not expect any other initials.

On the OR Record 'Anesthesiologist/CRNA:' tick-box line, the printed options on this mission are PK / DA / W, plus a write-in 'Other:' line. Report whichever is ticked exactly as printed, or transcribe the write-in if 'Other' is used -- do not expect any other initials.

This mission's Anesthesia Record 'CRNA/Resident (Print)' handwritten name reads a single name on the sample packets, consistent with the 'DA' tick-box option -- treat this as a sanity-check signal only, never force a match if the handwriting looks different on a given packet.
